timeline_convergence.title: The Convergence of Fates
timeline_convergence.subtitle: Three Lords, Three Lies, One Choice
timeline_convergence.objective: Reunite the scattered party across timelines and determine which faction—if any—to ally with to escape the fractured manor.
timeline_convergence.description:
The dinner party descended into chaos. Green T shot the Oracle. Vivesna was revealed to be 'Vivian Man of Shadow'—a male thrall who had been impersonating the heir. The party has scattered across multiple locations and timelines.

**CURRENT PARTY LOCATIONS:**

**Archie & Green T (Shadeward → Material Plane):**
Escaped the dinner chaos through a window. Traveled for days away from the manor. Currently sheltering in an abandoned infirmary. They observed the crashed Vigilance swarmed by Iron Legion and heard propaganda broadcasts.

**Markop, Remi, Bowser, Salam, Eager (Shadeward Manor):**
Trapped in the aftermath of the dinner chaos. Toadburt was captured. They attempted to escape during the chaos but status is uncertain. Franklin (Mages Guild) went after the Entropy Ring.

**Hjumpik, Waluigi, Toad Lee, Rakasha (Faeward Manor):**
Exploring the fey manor. Encountered the hag's hut and barely escaped. Now in the greenhouse with sprites. Have met 'The Revel'—a horrific entity of gluttony. Hjumpik has been contacted by both the Mages Guild (via ring) and Perrius Annmatar (telepathically).

**THE ORACLE STATUS:** Shot by Green T with a silver bullet. Slumped over the dinner table. Status unknown—silver may or may not kill an Oracle.

**THE HEIR REVELATION:** Vivesna Corvinarus was actually 'Vivian Man of Shadow'—a male thrall crossdressing as the legitimate heir. He declared 'I win!' as chaos erupted. The succession of Shadeward is now in dispute.

perrius_annmatar.name: Perrius Annmatar (The Ghost)
perrius_annmatar.goal: Kill BOTH heirs (Shadeward and Faeward). Fake-kill two Oracles. Sever the family tree.
perrius_annmatar.method: Manipulation, possession, guiding party to assassinate
perrius_annmatar.reward_offered: Escape, answers about the manor's true nature
perrius_annmatar.consequence: Two oracles remain. Family line severed. 'Even is balanced, odd is irregular.'
perrius_annmatar.notes: Has been helping the party but has his own agenda. Told Hjumpik: 'Kill all heirs, not the main one.' Claims crystals keep monsters IN, not OUT.
perrius_annmatar.implications: If both heirs die, the Corvinarus bloodline ends. No legitimate ruler for either Shadeward or Faeward. The oracles lose their anchors. Power vacuum.

mages_guild.name: The Mages Guild
mages_guild.method: Entropy Regulator Rings, political infiltration, assassination
mages_guild.consequence: No oracles remain. Probability untethers completely. Magic destabilizes.
mages_guild.notes: Franklin went after the Entropy Ring during chaos. Hjumpik's ring is at 24% entropy. They intercepted FNG's vessel research notes.
mages_guild.implications: Zero oracles means probability has no anchor. Events become truly random—or completely deterministic. Reality may unravel.

the_oracle.name: The Self-Reflection Oracle
the_oracle.goal: Merge all timelines into one, killing the other two oracles
the_oracle.reward_offered: Completion of the original mission, escape from the manor
the_oracle.consequence: One oracle remains. Probability becomes 100%. Absolute certainty.
the_oracle.notes: Currently shot by Green T. Status unknown. Was orchestrating the entire dinner to 'force convergence.'
the_oracle.implications: 100% probability means no chance, no luck, no free will. Everything becomes predetermined. The Oracle becomes the sole arbiter of fate.

aurelian_corvinarus.name: Aurelian Corvinarus (Faeward)
aurelian_corvinarus.goal: Subdue (not kill) her timeline's heir. Keep timelines separate. Protect the Fae from other timelines.
aurelian_corvinarus.reward_offered: Return home for three people. Sever Mages Guild connection.
aurelian_corvinarus.consequence: Timelines remain fractured but stable. Faeward becomes isolated. Party may be split permanently.
aurelian_corvinarus.notes: Made deal about clearing satyrs. Her 'special arrangement' was detected as a lie. She wants the party to work for 5 nights.
aurelian_corvinarus.implications: Isolation preserves Faeward but abandons Shadeward and the Void. Those left behind may never escape.

orangus_cornelius.name: Orangus Cornelius (Shadeward)
orangus_cornelius.goal: Protect Kryn (real heir) from Vivesna (fake heir). Make Onyx Hand timeline dominant.
orangus_cornelius.reward_offered: Unknown—was testing the party before chaos erupted
orangus_cornelius.consequence: If successful, Shadeward becomes the 'true' timeline. The living serve the undead.
orangus_cornelius.notes: His dinner party was disrupted. Vivesna/Vivian's deception was exposed. Kryn's legitimacy is now the focus. Orangus is likely hunting the party.
orangus_cornelius.implications: Vampiric dominion. Kryn rules as heir under Orangus's control. Mortals become cattle or servants.

vivian_man_of_shadow.name: Vivian Man of Shadow (Former 'Vivesna')
vivian_man_of_shadow.goal: Usurp the Corvinarus line. Become the new heir through deception.
vivian_man_of_shadow.method: Impersonation, manipulation, waiting for the right moment
vivian_man_of_shadow.consequence: A thrall rules Shadeward. The bloodline is corrupted. Orangus's authority is undermined.
vivian_man_of_shadow.notes: Revealed himself during the chaos, shouting 'I win!' Was crossdressing as the female heir Vivesna. A thrall who tricked the vampire lord.
vivian_man_of_shadow.implications: If Vivian succeeds, a false heir rules. The Corvinarus legacy becomes a lie. Orangus may seek revenge or be destroyed.

oracle_shot.event: Green T shot the Oracle with a silver bullet during dinner
oracle_shot.implications: If dead: One oracle down. If alive: Oracle knows Green T tried to kill it.
oracle_shot.party_committed: The party is now enemies of the Oracle faction regardless

vivesna_imposter.event: Vivesna Corvinarus revealed to be 'Vivian Man of Shadow'
vivesna_imposter.truth: Male thrall who was crossdressing as the legitimate female heir
vivesna_imposter.declaration: 'I win! I win!' as chaos erupted
vivesna_imposter.implications: Succession crisis in Shadeward. Orangus was deceived. Kryn is now the only 'legitimate' heir.
vivesna_imposter.archie_action: Archie tried to expose Vivian publicly but chaos drowned him out

usk_mutilated.event: Archie cut off Usk's finger with a crystalline knife
usk_mutilated.context: Orangus forced Archie to choose: carve Usk or offer his own hand
usk_mutilated.consequence: Usk may be dying or dead. Usk was described as 'faithful confidant' in the vessel research notes.

crystals_truth.perrius_claim: Crystals keep monsters IN, not OUT. Oracle is lying.
crystals_truth.oracle_claim: Crystals anchor the ritual. External threats are the danger.
crystals_truth.green_t_claim: Need to uncontain the beast to merge 2 into 1.
crystals_truth.unresolved: True nature of containment still unclear

observations: Saw crashed Vigilance swarmed by Iron Legion
Heard propaganda: 'THE ANOMALY IS CONTAINED. COMPLIANCE IS MANDATORY.'
Possibly saw 'the real Dan' near the crash site
Green T has flintlock pistol and war pick
archie_green_t.goal: Regroup with others, investigate Vigilance situation

complications: Eager was caught and shoved in closet
markop_group.goal: Escape the manor, rescue captured allies

complications: Waluigi had broken leg (healed by sprites)
Rakasha acting strangely strong and giddy
Hjumpik has Mages Guild ring (24% entropy)
intel_received: Perrius: Kill all heirs except main one
Mages Guild: Intercepted vessel research notes
OC and OS initials on tree (Orangus Cornelius and Sundaria?)
hjumpik_group.goal: Find Archie, navigate Aurelian's deal, survive the Revel

timeline_convergence.primaryObjective: The Shadeward party and Faeward party must find a way to meet and share information before choosing a faction—or finding a way to defy them all.

side_with_perrius.action: Kill both heirs (Kryn in Shadeward, unknown in Faeward). Fake-kill two Oracles.
side_with_perrius.result: Corvinarus bloodline ends. Two Oracles remain. Ghost gains influence.
side_with_perrius.cost: Must commit murder. Become enemies of both manors. Unknown 'balance' effects.

side_with_mages_guild.result: Probability untethers. Magic destabilizes. Reality may unravel.
side_with_mages_guild.cost: Become tools of the Guild. Face unknown apocalyptic scenario.

side_with_oracle.result: One Oracle survives. Probability locks at 100%. No free will.
side_with_oracle.cost: Oracle may be dead. If alive, they know Green T shot them.

side_with_aurelian.action: Clear satyrs. Work for 5 nights. Accept her terms.
side_with_aurelian.result: Three party members can leave. Faeward isolates. Others trapped.
side_with_aurelian.cost: Party split permanently. Abandon those in other timelines.

side_with_orangus.action: Help establish Kryn as true heir. Serve the Onyx Hand.
side_with_orangus.result: Vampiric dominion. Shadeward becomes dominant timeline.
side_with_orangus.cost: Become servants of vampires. Mortals become cattle.

reject_all.action: Find a way to escape without serving any faction.
reject_all.result: Unknown. Possibly everyone survives. Possibly everyone dies.
reject_all.cost: Every faction becomes an enemy. Must find a fourth path.

free_the_beast.action: Shatter all crystals. Release the entity beneath the manor.
free_the_beast.result: All factions devoured. All timelines dissolve. You are the only souls left.
free_the_beast.cost: You are the new gods. Every choice shapes reality. There is no going back.

feed_the_revel.action: Offer one party member to The Revel as a permanent host.
feed_the_revel.result: The Revel is sated for a century. Faeward stabilizes. Aurelian owes you everything.
feed_the_revel.cost: Your friend is conscious inside it forever. Watching. Screaming. Digesting slowly.

become_the_revel.action: Willingly merge with The Revel. Absorb its power.
become_the_revel.result: You become an entity of infinite hunger. All of Faeward bows to you.
become_the_revel.cost: You forget your name. Your friends. Your humanity. Only appetite remains.

weaponize_crystals.action: Use the crystals to trap a faction leader inside.
weaponize_crystals.result: One enemy is permanently imprisoned. Their faction crumbles without leadership.
weaponize_crystals.cost: You must feed the crystal a soul every month or it cracks and releases them.

reverse_containment.action: Invert the crystals. Turn them outward instead of inward.
reverse_containment.result: Whatever the crystals held now protects you. An army of horrors at your command.
reverse_containment.cost: They obey, but they whisper. Every night. Louder. Until you cannot tell their thoughts from yours.

betray_green_t.action: Surrender Green T to the Oracle as atonement.
betray_green_t.result: The Oracle forgives the party. Convergence proceeds peacefully.
betray_green_t.cost: You hear Green T's screams in your dreams forever.

betray_archie.action: Give Archie to Orangus as payment for the greenhouse.
betray_archie.result: The debt is settled. Orangus becomes a powerful ally.
betray_archie.cost: Archie burns for three days. He survives. He remembers who handed him over.

betray_hjumpik.action: Steal Hjumpik's Entropy Ring and deliver it to the Mages Guild.
betray_hjumpik.result: The Guild rewards you handsomely. They owe you a favor.
betray_hjumpik.cost: Hjumpik's entropy destabilizes. He becomes a walking probability storm.

betray_bowser.action: Lure Bowser into a trap set by Aurelian's fey hunters.
betray_bowser.result: Aurelian trusts you completely. Full access to Faeward secrets.
betray_bowser.cost: Bowser's shell hangs on her wall. He is still alive inside it.

betray_waluigi.action: Report Waluigi's chaos magic to Orangus.
betray_waluigi.result: Orangus offers protection. The vampires shield you from the Mages Guild.
betray_waluigi.cost: Waluigi is drained slowly over months. Used as a battery for Shadeward's wards.

betray_toad_lee.action: Sell Toad Lee's location to the Iron Legion.
betray_toad_lee.result: The Legion stops hunting you. You receive safe passage through the material plane.
betray_toad_lee.cost: Toad Lee vanishes into a black site. No one knows what they do there.

betray_rakasha.action: Expose Rakasha's unnatural strength to Aurelian.
betray_rakasha.result: Aurelian investigates. Discovers Rakasha is marked by something ancient.
betray_rakasha.cost: Rakasha is dissected alive to study the mark. She survives. Barely.

sacrifice_self_to_oracle.action: Offer yourself as the Oracle's new vessel.
sacrifice_self_to_oracle.result: Your friends escape. All of them. The Oracle is satisfied.
sacrifice_self_to_oracle.cost: You see all timelines at once. You know everything. You can do nothing.

sacrifice_self_to_perrius.result: Perrius has a body again. He honors his deal. Everyone goes home.
sacrifice_self_to_perrius.cost: You are a passenger in your own flesh. Watching. Screaming silently.

sacrifice_fire_forever.action: Archie permanently surrenders his fire magic to restore the party.
sacrifice_fire_forever.result: Everyone is healed. Everyone escapes. Archie is whole and free.
sacrifice_fire_forever.cost: Archie will never cast fire again. He will be cold. Always cold.

sacrifice_memories.action: Erase all memories of the manor from the party's minds.
sacrifice_memories.result: You wake up outside. Safe. No trauma. No nightmares.
sacrifice_memories.cost: You forget each other. You walk away as strangers and never reconnect.

sacrifice_future.action: Trade your future to the Oracle. All of it.
sacrifice_future.result: The Oracle gives you anything you want right now. Anything.
sacrifice_future.cost: You have no future. You will die within one year. Nothing can stop it.

sacrifice_name.action: Give your true name to Aurelian.
sacrifice_name.result: She grants you permanent sanctuary in Faeward. You are protected forever.
sacrifice_name.cost: She owns you. One word from her and you obey. Anything. Everything.

merge_two_timelines.action: Force Shadeward and Faeward together. Leave the Void alone.
merge_two_timelines.result: Two Oracles merge. One timeline of vampires and fey. Uneasy but stable.
merge_two_timelines.cost: The Void collapses. Everyone trapped there—Toadburt, Eager—is erased.

isolate_shadeward.action: Sever Shadeward from all other timelines.
isolate_shadeward.result: Orangus rules alone. He cannot threaten anyone else ever again.
isolate_shadeward.cost: Markop's group is trapped there. They become cattle. Or worse.

isolate_faeward.action: Sever Faeward from all other timelines.
isolate_faeward.result: Aurelian's paradise is sealed. The Revel cannot spread.
isolate_faeward.cost: Hjumpik's group is trapped there. Time moves differently. They age. Fast.

loop_the_dinner.action: Trap the dinner party in a time loop forever.
loop_the_dinner.result: Orangus, Vivian, Kryn, the Oracle—all frozen. Reliving the same meal eternally.
loop_the_dinner.cost: Anyone who was there is trapped too. Including Bowser. Including Archie.

rewind_before_the_shot.action: Reset time to before Green T shot the Oracle.
rewind_before_the_shot.result: The Oracle is alive. No chaos. No hunt. Fresh start.
rewind_before_the_shot.cost: You remember everything. The Oracle remembers nothing. But it will figure it out.

accelerate_shadeward.action: Speed up time in Shadeward by a hundred years.
accelerate_shadeward.result: Orangus's court crumbles. New powers rise. The vampires scatter.
accelerate_shadeward.cost: Everyone you left behind is dead. Toadburt. Eager. Salam. Dust.

pause_faeward.action: Freeze Faeward in a single moment forever.
pause_faeward.result: The Revel stops mid-bite. Aurelian stops mid-sentence. Safe. Still.
pause_faeward.cost: Hjumpik's group is frozen too. Conscious. Unable to move. Forever.

bargain_with_usk.action: Offer to restore Usk's finger in exchange for his secrets.
bargain_with_usk.result: Usk reveals Orangus's true weakness. The vampire lord can be killed.
bargain_with_usk.cost: To restore the finger, you must cut off your own. Pain is memory.

bargain_with_kryn.action: Help Kryn overthrow Orangus. Support a coup.
bargain_with_kryn.result: Kryn rules Shadeward. Young, grateful, and in your debt.
bargain_with_kryn.cost: Kryn is worse than Orangus. You just handed a monster his crown.

bargain_with_franklin.action: Help Franklin obtain the Entropy Ring. In exchange, he smuggles you out.
bargain_with_franklin.result: Freedom. Clean. No faction ties. The Guild owes you nothing.
bargain_with_franklin.cost: Franklin uses the ring to collapse a timeline. Thousands die. Your hands are clean. Technically.

bargain_with_hag.action: Return to the Hag's hut. Make a deal.
bargain_with_hag.result: She gives you exactly what you ask for. Word for word.
bargain_with_hag.cost: She takes something you didn't know you had. You won't miss it until it's too late.

bargain_with_sprites.action: Promise the sprites a favor in exchange for passage.
bargain_with_sprites.result: Safe travel through all of Faeward. Invisible to The Revel.
bargain_with_sprites.cost: Sprites collect. Always. The favor will be absurd, dangerous, and binding.

bargain_with_dan.action: Find the real Dan. Learn what he knows about the Vigilance.
bargain_with_dan.result: Dan reveals the Legion's weakness. The propaganda is a lie.
bargain_with_dan.cost: Dan is not Dan. Not anymore. Something is wearing his face.

bargain_with_iron_legion.action: Surrender to the Iron Legion. Offer intel on the anomaly.
bargain_with_iron_legion.result: The Legion contains the manor. No one can enter or leave. Problem solved.
bargain_with_iron_legion.cost: You are contained too. Forever. The Legion does not release assets.

read_all_onyx_books.action: Archie reads every Onyx Hand book. All of them. Cover to cover.
read_all_onyx_books.result: He learns the true history. The Corvinarus family. The first Oracle. Everything.
read_all_onyx_books.cost: The books are vampiric. Each page drains a year of life. Archie ages decades in hours.

learn_oracle_name.action: Discover the Oracle's true name before it became an Oracle.
learn_oracle_name.result: Names have power. You can command the Oracle. Once.
learn_oracle_name.cost: The Oracle will spend eternity hunting whoever knows. You cannot forget.

expose_vivian_publicly.action: Broadcast Vivian's imposture to all of Shadeward.
expose_vivian_publicly.result: Vivian is torn apart by the court. The succession crisis ends.
expose_vivian_publicly.cost: You made an enemy of every thrall in existence. They have long memories.

uncover_os_identity.action: Discover who 'OS' on the tree really was. Orangus's lost love.
uncover_os_identity.result: Orangus breaks. Completely. He will do anything you ask. Anything.
uncover_os_identity.cost: You learn she is still alive. Trapped somewhere. And Orangus will burn worlds to find her.

decode_vessel_notes.action: Fully decode FNG's vessel research notes.
decode_vessel_notes.result: You understand how the Oracles were made. You could make more. Or unmake them.
decode_vessel_notes.cost: The knowledge changes you. You start seeing probabilities. Everywhere. All the time.

reveal_entropy_truth.action: Discover what happens when entropy reaches 100%.
reveal_entropy_truth.result: You understand the ring. You can control it. Weaponize it.
reveal_entropy_truth.cost: At 100%, you don't die. You become a possibility. All possibilities. None of them you.

ally_perrius_and_aurelian.action: Convince Perrius and Aurelian to work together against the Oracle.
ally_perrius_and_aurelian.result: Ghost and fey unite. The Oracle cannot fight both. Victory is certain.
ally_perrius_and_aurelian.cost: Perrius possesses Aurelian afterward. Faeward becomes a haunted nightmare.

ally_orangus_and_aurelian.action: Reunite the Corvinarus bloodline. Vampire and fey together.
ally_orangus_and_aurelian.result: The family is whole. Both timelines stabilize. The Oracles lose leverage.
ally_orangus_and_aurelian.cost: They remember why they separated. The war resumes. You are in the middle.

ally_mages_guild_and_perrius.action: Broker a deal between the Guild and the Ghost.
ally_mages_guild_and_perrius.result: Combined power to kill all Oracles. Reality will be rewritten.
ally_mages_guild_and_perrius.cost: They plan to rule together. You will be subjects of a ghost-mage empire.

ally_satyrs_and_party.action: Recruit the satyrs instead of expelling them.
ally_satyrs_and_party.result: Drunk chaos army. They will fight anything. They will party anywhere.
ally_satyrs_and_party.cost: They never leave. You have satyrs now. Forever. They are your problem.

ally_revel_and_party.action: Feed The Revel enemies instead of fighting it.
ally_revel_and_party.result: The Revel is your weapon. Point it at anyone. It devours them.
ally_revel_and_party.cost: It needs to eat. Always. You must keep feeding it or it turns on you.

ally_iron_legion_and_party.action: Convince the Iron Legion you can contain the anomaly better.
ally_iron_legion_and_party.result: Legion resources. Weapons. Soldiers. You are deputized.
ally_iron_legion_and_party.cost: Compliance is mandatory. You follow orders now. Forever.

destroy_entropy_ring.result: Mages Guild loses tracking. You disappear from their sight forever.
destroy_entropy_ring.cost: The stored entropy releases. Reality fractures around Hjumpik. Permanent scars.

overcharge_entropy_ring.action: Push the ring past 100%. Force a controlled overload.
overcharge_entropy_ring.result: A probability bomb. Destroys anything within range. Complete annihilation.
overcharge_entropy_ring.cost: Hjumpik is at the center. He survives but exists in all states simultaneously.

gift_morning_glory.action: Give the Morning Glory weapon to Aurelian.
gift_morning_glory.result: She is deeply moved. Full alliance. No more tests. No more deals.
gift_morning_glory.cost: She uses it to kill her heir. She always hated them. You armed her.

weaponize_onyx_books.action: Use the Onyx Hand books as a trap for Franklin.
weaponize_onyx_books.result: Franklin is corrupted by the books. The Mages Guild loses their agent.
weaponize_onyx_books.cost: The books consume Franklin. He becomes a new threat. Smarter. Hungrier.

trade_flintlock_to_orangus.action: Give Green T's silver-loaded flintlock to Orangus.
trade_flintlock_to_orangus.result: Orangus trusts you. You are elevated to his inner circle.
trade_flintlock_to_orangus.cost: He uses it on Kryn. His own heir. You armed a murderer.

swap_bodies_with_vivian.action: Use Faeward magic to swap bodies with Vivian.
swap_bodies_with_vivian.result: You become the heir. Vivian is trapped in your body.
swap_bodies_with_vivian.cost: Vivian in your body runs. Disappears. Uses your face to do terrible things.

let_perrius_possess_bowser.action: Offer Bowser as a vessel for Perrius Annmatar.
let_perrius_possess_bowser.result: Perrius in Bowser's body is unstoppable. Shadeward falls in hours.
let_perrius_possess_bowser.cost: Bowser is still in there. Watching Perrius use his hands to kill.

split_the_oracle.action: Instead of killing the Oracle, divide it into three weaker beings.
split_the_oracle.result: Three small Oracles. Weak. Manageable. Probability becomes flexible.
split_the_oracle.cost: They hate each other. They scheme. They grow. One will win eventually.

absorb_usk_memories.action: Use the crystalline knife to absorb Usk's memories.
absorb_usk_memories.result: You know everything Usk knew. Every secret. Every weakness.
absorb_usk_memories.cost: Usk's loyalty bleeds into you. You feel compelled to serve Orangus.

steal_rakasha_strength.action: Transfer Rakasha's unnatural strength to yourself.
steal_rakasha_strength.result: You are powerful. Unnaturally so. The play-bliss is yours now.
steal_rakasha_strength.cost: Rakasha becomes fragile. Weak. She trusted you.

collapse_the_greenhouse.result: The sprites die. The connections to other timelines weaken.
collapse_the_greenhouse.cost: Aurelian's power comes from the greenhouse. She becomes desperate. Dangerous.

seal_the_attic_mirror.action: Permanently seal the mirror in Shadeward's attic.
seal_the_attic_mirror.result: No more timeline crossings through that point. Shadeward is isolated.
seal_the_attic_mirror.cost: Anyone on the other side when it seals is trapped forever.

burn_the_hags_hut.action: Destroy the Hag's hut before anyone else can make deals.
burn_the_hags_hut.result: The Hag dies. No more dark bargains. Faeward becomes slightly safer.
burn_the_hags_hut.cost: Everything she was owed comes due. Every deal collapses. Chaos follows.

claim_the_lords_chamber.action: Take the Faeward Lord's Chamber for yourself.
claim_the_lords_chamber.result: You are recognized as a power in Faeward. Goblins and sprites serve you.
claim_the_lords_chamber.cost: Aurelian will not share. She will come for you. Soon.

fortify_abandoned_infirmary.action: Turn the abandoned infirmary into a permanent base.
fortify_abandoned_infirmary.result: Safe haven. Hidden from all factions. A place to rest and plan.
fortify_abandoned_infirmary.cost: The infirmary has ghosts. They remember patients. They want more.

salvage_the_vigilance.action: Sneak into the crashed Vigilance and salvage what you can.
salvage_the_vigilance.result: Weapons. Intel. Supplies. Enough to fight back properly.
salvage_the_vigilance.cost: The Iron Legion notices. They tighten the perimeter. Escape becomes harder.

break_the_fourth_wall.action: Acknowledge that you are in a story. Speak to something beyond.
break_the_fourth_wall.result: The DM blinks. Reality shudders. You are given one impossible boon.
break_the_fourth_wall.cost: You know too much. The world feels thin. You can never unsee the seams.

refuse_to_choose.action: Do nothing. Wait. Let events unfold without interference.
refuse_to_choose.result: The factions destroy each other. Someone wins. You are collateral.
refuse_to_choose.cost: You had agency. You gave it away. The ending is not yours.

choose_everything.action: Attempt to ally with every faction simultaneously.
choose_everything.result: Impossible. They all discover your lies. They unite against you.
choose_everything.cost: Every door closes. Every ally becomes an enemy. You are alone.

erase_yourself.action: Use the entropy ring to erase yourself from all timelines.
erase_yourself.result: No one remembers you. You never existed. Your friends are free of you.
erase_yourself.cost: You watch from nowhere. You see them move on. You cannot return.

create_fourth_timeline.action: Force the fracture wider. Create a fourth timeline. Your timeline.
create_fourth_timeline.result: A pocket reality where you make the rules. Sanctuary.
create_fourth_timeline.cost: It drains the other three. They weaken. The factions blame you.

loop_yourself.action: Trap yourself in a time loop to try every possibility.
loop_yourself.result: You find the perfect solution. Eventually. After thousands of loops.
loop_yourself.cost: You remember every loop. Every death. Every failure. You are not sane when you escape.

confess_to_orangus.action: Tell Orangus the full truth. Everything. Hold nothing back.
confess_to_orangus.result: He is stunned. He respects honesty. He offers a genuine alliance.
confess_to_orangus.cost: He knows everything now. Every weakness. Every secret. He will use them.

forgive_vivian.action: Offer Vivian mercy. Help him escape instead of exposing him.
forgive_vivian.result: Vivian is loyal. Genuinely. He becomes a powerful hidden ally.
forgive_vivian.cost: Kryn dies. Vivian was always going to kill him. You just delayed it.

mourn_toadburt.action: Spend precious time holding a funeral for Toadburt if he dies.
mourn_toadburt.result: The party bonds. Morale stabilizes. You remember why you fight.
mourn_toadburt.cost: Time passes. Factions move. Opportunities close while you grieve.

save_usk.action: Risk everything to save Usk from bleeding out.
save_usk.result: Usk lives. He is grateful. He will betray Orangus for you.
save_usk.cost: Orangus notices. He knows Usk is compromised. He will test you both.

reunite_the_party_at_any_cost.action: Prioritize getting everyone together. Nothing else matters.
reunite_the_party_at_any_cost.result: The party reunites. Full strength. Full intel. Ready for anything.
reunite_the_party_at_any_cost.cost: You ignored the factions. They have moved. The board has changed.

leave_someone_behind.action: Escape with most of the party. Leave one person to buy time.
leave_someone_behind.result: Clean escape. No casualties except one. The math works.
leave_someone_behind.cost: Someone you love dies alone. They trusted you. You left them.

sacrifice_to_the_revel.action: Feed one party member to The Revel (the gluttony entity).
sacrifice_to_the_revel.result: The Revel is sated and retreats. The Faeward Manor stabilizes. Aurelian is so impressed she lets everyone go free.
sacrifice_to_the_revel.cost: That party member is digested. They return to the Material Plane... as a sentient, agonizing pile of feces in a flowerpot. They are conscious. They cannot speak.

become_the_anchor.action: Destroy the crystals. One party member takes their place as the living anchor.
become_the_anchor.result: The timelines stabilize. The manor is saved. The other party members can go home.
become_the_anchor.cost: The chosen member becomes a statue. They are conscious, unable to move, for 100 years. They feel every rain, every bird that lands on them. Forever.

franklins_ascension.action: Give the Entropy Ring to Franklin. Let him complete his mission.
franklins_ascension.result: Franklin ascends to Lichdom. He opens a portal home for the party out of gratitude.
franklins_ascension.cost: Franklin becomes the new Dark Lord of this plane. The Mages Guild takes over the manor. You just doomed the world to 500 years of magical tyranny.

the_vampire_spawn.action: Drink Orangus's blood willingly. Become his 'favorite'.
the_vampire_spawn.result: You gain immense power. You are a Vampire Lord, second only to Orangus. You rule the night.
the_vampire_spawn.cost: You lose your soul. You can no longer enter a home uninvited. You must kill a civilian every week or wither to dust. Your old friends are now just 'food' to you.

trapped_in_the_play.action: Join the Satyrs' 'party' permanently. Never leave the greenhouse.
trapped_in_the_play.result: You live in eternal bliss. The wine never runs out. The high never fades. It's always summer.
trapped_in_the_play.cost: You forget your names. You forget the outside world. You are now a mindless NPC in Aurelian's play, repeating the same lines forever.

perrius_puppet.action: Make a deal with Perrius: Kill Aurelian for him.
perrius_puppet.result: Perrius destroys the Faeward timeline. You escape to the Material Plane with a bag of gold.
perrius_puppet.cost: Perrius now owns your shadow. Whenever you sleep, he possesses your body to commit murders. You wake up with blood on your hands.

the_probability_ghost.action: Let the Oracle merge the timelines, but YOU step into the beam.
the_probability_ghost.result: You become a being of pure probability. You can reroll reality once per day.
the_probability_ghost.cost: You are erased from everyone's memory. Your friends don't know who you are. You are a ghost in your own life.

merge_with_vivian.action: Help Vivian, then betray him at the last second and take the throne yourself.
merge_with_vivian.result: You are the new Master of Shadeward. You have an army of shadows.
merge_with_vivian.cost: The manor hates you. The walls bleed when you walk by. The food turns to ash in your mouth. You are utterly, cosmically alone.

destroy_the_ring.action: Smash Hjumpik's Entropy Ring with a hammer.
destroy_the_ring.result: A massive explosion of raw magic tears a hole in the Void. Everyone escapes through the hole.
destroy_the_ring.cost: Hjumpik is the epicenter. He is atomized. Gone. Not even dust remains. The ring was bonded to his soul.

usk_the_key.action: Use Usk's severed finger (from the research notes) to unlock the Void Gate.
usk_the_key.result: The gate opens. The party escapes back to the Material Plane.
usk_the_key.cost: Usk's spirit is now attached to your party. He whispers criticisms of your combat tactics in your ear during every fight. Forever.

become_the_monster.action: Open all the cages in the Void specimen tanks.
become_the_monster.result: Chaos erupts. In the confusion, the party slips away and escapes.
become_the_monster.cost: The creatures swarm the Material Plane. You are responsible for a plague of eldritch horrors. You are now a 'Wanted: Apocalypse-Level' criminal.

the_fools_bargain.action: Trick Perrius into possessing a toilet.
the_fools_bargain.result: Perrius is trapped. The Ghost is gone. The timelines stabilize naturally.
the_fools_bargain.cost: Perrius knows it was you. When you die, your soul won't go to the afterlife. It will go to the toilet. To be flushed. Forever.

dinner_party_aftermath.title: Blood on the Tablecloth
dinner_party_aftermath.subtitle: The Dinner That Ended in Gunfire
dinner_party_aftermath.objective: Escape the aftermath of the disastrous dinner party. Account for all party members. Determine the Oracle's fate.
dinner_party_aftermath.description:
The dinner party has collapsed into violence. Green T shot the Oracle. Vivian revealed his deception. Bowser breathed fire. The room erupted into chaos.

**WHAT HAPPENED:**
- Green T shot the Oracle with a silver bullet from a hidden position
- The Oracle slumped over the table (status unknown)
- Archie exposed Vivesna as an imposter (chaos drowned him out)
- Vivesna revealed herself as 'Vivian Man of Shadow' and declared victory
- Bowser unleashed fire breath
- Kryn attacked Green T (biting his neck?)
- Franklin (Mages Guild) went after the Entropy Ring
- Archie and Green T escaped through a window
- Guards flooded in, demanding surrender

**CURRENT STATUS:**
- Archie & Green T: Escaped (now at abandoned infirmary, days later)
- Bowser: Last seen fighting in the chaos
- Markop: Attempted to lead toads to escape
- Remi: At dinner table when chaos erupted
- Toadburt: Captured (ring removed?)
- Eager: Caught, shoved in closet
- Salam: With Markop's group

**THE ORACLE:** Shot and slumped over. If alive, they know Green T pulled the trigger. If dead, one of three Oracles is eliminated.

chaosTimeline.event: Archie opens kitchen door, discovers candy was poison
Archie finds Green T hiding, learns the 'plan'
Green T fires. Oracle falls. Screams of 'GUARDS!'
Bowser roars, fire everywhere. Kryn attacks Green T.
Vivian reveals himself, declares victory. Guards flood in.
Archie and Green T exit through window, land in rose bushes.
Franklin chases the Entropy Ring. Party scatters.

The Liberated Toads need allies. The Rakasha have allies to spare—smuggler networks, safe houses, spirit-walkers who can read the movement of enemies before they arrive. But Thornpaw doesn't deal in promises. He deals in proof.

The delegation—Embercap, Dewdrop, and Erick—jumped from Cheep-Cheep Falls onto a smuggler's skiff, surviving the Rakasha's first test: a psychological gauntlet designed to weed out cowards. They arrived in Rogueport bruised but breathing, only to walk directly into an ambush. Iron Legion soldiers had been tipped off. Local thugs smelled opportunity. The Tiger summon—a one-use spirit bound to Embercap's totem—was burned to escape the kill box.

Now they're in the Trade Ward with no backup summon, no extraction plan, and a target building marked only by a purple emblem. Whatever Thornpaw wants retrieved, he wants it badly enough to stake the entire alliance on three Toads and a prayer.

The Iron Mandate passed this morning. Legion patrols have emergency powers. The city that was already hostile is now a hunting ground.

festival_of_the_fallen_pact.description:
The Festival of the Fallen is not a celebration. It is a negotiation conducted through chemistry and willpower.

Mystivil and Big R attended the Rakasha's sacred rite, consuming 'Xeos'—a hallucinogenic compound that tears down the barriers between minds. In that shared dreamspace, Mystivil negotiated directly with an avatar of Chief Thornpaw. The price of the Rakasha's full support was not gold or blood. It was territory.

The Rakasha have interests in Rogueport—smuggling routes, safe houses, debts owed by powerful criminals. Those interests are threatened by the Iron Legion's expanding reach and the chaos of the underworld's power struggles. Thornpaw wants the Peach Loyalists to take control of a specific district and protect Rakasha operations there. Not as conquerors extracting tribute—as guardians maintaining order.

This puts the Loyalists in Rogueport at the exact moment a Liberated Toad delegation is conducting a heist in the Trade Ward. Two factions who share enemies but not trust, operating in the same lawless city, with the Iron Legion hunting both.

The Iron Mandate complicates everything. Legion patrols now have emergency powers. The Supernatural Sovereignty Act makes organized supernatural entities—including the Rakasha—illegal. A Loyalist garrison protecting Rakasha interests is technically sedition.

consequences.success: The Peach Loyalists gain Thornpaw's full support—a spy network spanning the continent, smuggling routes, and the Rakasha's spiritual warriors. The garrison becomes a foothold in Rogueport's criminal underworld.

consequences.partial: The garrison is established but conflicts with locals, the Legion, or the Liberated Toads undermine its stability. Thornpaw offers limited, probationary support.

liberated_toads_integration.subtitle: Order 120 — Execute Them All
liberated_toads_integration.objective: Survive Order 120, rescue Bones and Creek from Aegis Command, and locate the real Speaker L before the Legion realizes they've been deceived.
liberated_toads_integration.description:
Everything has gone wrong.

Bones infiltrated the Imperial Processing Facility at Aegis Command disguised as a Legion guard. For hours, it worked. He walked the corridors of an industrial nightmare—a complex designed to process prisoners at scale. He witnessed the arrival of the captured Toads. He saw the interrogation of the 'Green Speaker L.'

The prisoner wasn't the real Speaker L. It was a decoy—a loyalist who claimed, under torture, that he'd eaten a poisonous mushroom and was dying anyway. The decoy spoke of the 'Fractured Heart' philosophy, of the Council of Seven, of how the movement would survive any single death. The interrogators were getting nothing useful.

Then Marcus Ironhand arrived.

The General of the Iron Legion didn't ask questions. He looked at the decoy, looked at the reports, looked at Bones standing too still in his borrowed uniform—and stabbed Bones through the chest without a word of warning. Cover blown. Mission failed.

In the chaos that followed, a Toad raiding party led by Creek attempted extraction. Acid attacks. Collateral damage. Legion casualties. It bought time, nothing more.

Ironhand's response was Order 120: Execute all Toad prisoners immediately. No trials. No ransoms. No exceptions.

The clock is now measured in hours. Bones is wounded and captured. Creek is pinned down somewhere in the facility. The decoy is still performing his role, buying time the real Speaker L—wherever they are—desperately needs.

And the party is trapped in Raventree Manor, watching the Vigilance fly overhead broadcasting Legion propaganda, unable to help.Archie found detailed notes about their activities left behind by a spy, suggesting progress on 'Survive Order 120' and 'locate the rea'.

consequences.success: Bones and Creek escape. The decoy's sacrifice buys enough time for the real Speaker L to reorganize. The movement survives decapitation.
consequences.failure: Order 120 is executed. Bones, Creek, and all captured Toads are killed. The movement loses its most experienced operatives and its organizational backbone.
consequences.partial: Some prisoners escape, others don't. The movement survives but is crippled. The Legion realizes the 'Green Speaker L' was a decoy and intensifies the hunt.

milestones.notes: The party is trapped in Raventree Manor. hjumpik has a Legion contact who might be leveraged. The Oracle might be used as a bargaining chip. Every option has a cost.

sessionNotes.content: The group is currently debating how to handle a color-changing creature and dealing with monster attacks.

archie_sleeper_protocol.title: The Ticking Toad
archie_sleeper_protocol.subtitle: Protocol: Entropy
archie_sleeper_protocol.objective: Locate Toadburt using Luigi's 'Poltergust' sensors and disarm the Entropy Ring before it detonates.
archie_sleeper_protocol.description:
The Mages' Guild agents revealed the truth: Toadburt is a sleeper agent equipped with an Entropy Ring—a magical nuke designed to sever the planar bridge. He is currently lost in the Manor, terrified and unstable.

Luigi, the Guild's 'Specialist', has arrived with ghost-hunting gear that can track the ring's signature. Archie must guide Luigi through the vampire-infested halls to find Toadburt. 

Warning: If Toadburt panics, he might trigger the ring manually.Archie found detailed notes about their activities left behind by a spy, potentially related to locating Toadburt.

consequences.success: Toadburt is saved and disarmed. The party gains a powerful explosive (The Ring).
consequences.failure: Toadburt detonates. The planar bridge collapses. Archie and Hjumpik are trapped in their respective dimensions forever.
consequences.partial: The ring is removed, but Toadburt is lost/captured by the Legion.

guaranteed.name: Luigi
guaranteed.description: Terrified but equipped with anti-ghost tech.

guaranteed.name: Entropy Ring (Disarmed)
guaranteed.description: A volatile magical core.

milestones.title: The Recruitment
milestones.description: Archie was 'recruited' by the Mages' Guild agents.

milestones.title: The Ghost Hunt
milestones.description: Use Luigi's sensors to track the Entropy signal through the Shadowfell Manor.

milestones.title: The Cut
milestones.description: Confront Toadburt. Disarm the ring (requires Magic Arcana or Thieves Tools).

archie_dinner_betrayal.title: The Guest List
archie_dinner_betrayal.subtitle: From Dinner to Desperation
archie_dinner_betrayal.objective: Escape Shadeward Manor and return to the material plane.
archie_dinner_betrayal.description: What began as a disastrous dinner party with Orangus Cornelius escalated into a full-blown jailbreak. After betraying his allies to maintain cover, Archie utilized a 'Dracacide' disguise to rescue Green T from a locked room. The duo navigated the horrors of the manor—ignoring a gruesome operating room—and escaped into the wastes. They have now returned to the crash site of the Vigilance, only to find it occupied by a mysterious 'Purple Legion'.However, their escape was complicated by the unexpected recognition of Bones by Byscilla Danos, who dragged him away. This raises concerns about potential future complications and the safety of those still within Shadeward Manor.

milestones.title: The Meal
milestones.description: Ate the Roast Beef. Tasted blood. Confirmed edible for vampires/guests.

milestones.title: The Outing
milestones.description: Yelled at escaping allies. Caused Eager's capture. Green T escaped capture.

milestones.title: The Escape
milestones.description: Shattered a barricaded door with willpower. Bluffed past guards using a 'Bureaucrat' disguise. Rescued Green T from under a bed.

milestones.title: The Crash Site
milestones.description: Investigate the crashed Vigilance and the 'Purple Legion' occupation. Determine the fate of the Liberated Toads.

milestones.title: Bones Recognized
milestones.description: Bones was recognized by Byscilla Danos and taken away, adding a new layer of complexity to the escape.

archie_fugitive_of_the_accords.title: Fugitive of the Accords
archie_fugitive_of_the_accords.subtitle: The Bearer's Circle
archie_fugitive_of_the_accords.objective: Channel energy for the Oracle's ritual while maintaining ice discipline. The War Mage's Staff awaits. The Oracles are multiple. The separation approaches.
archie_fugitive_of_the_accords.description: Archie failed to maintain control during the separation ritual. His ice magic destabilized, contributing to the planar fracture. The Mages' Guild observer (Pernus Annmatar) undoubtedly witnessed this failure. Archie's provisional license is forfeit; he is once again a rogue mage, and likely blamed for the destruction of the Manor.
archie_fugitive_of_the_accords.notes: The War Mage's Staff remains in Archie's possession, but the 'Bearer's Blessing' and Guild License rewards are lost.

consequences.success: Archie channels energy flawlessly through the War Mage's Staff. The ritual succeeds. The Guild grants a permanent license. The Oracle(s) recognize him as a valuable ally.
consequences.failure: Archie loses control during the ritual, causing a magical catastrophe. The Staff is destroyed. Immediate revocation of license and freedom. The timelines collapse.
consequences.partial: The ritual succeeds, but Archie's contribution is flawed. The Star Shard's power compensates. Archie earns grudging respect but not full acceptance.
consequences.fire_relapse: Archie uses fire during the ritual. It works perfectly. The Guild excommunicates him on the spot. Worth it? Only time will tell.

guaranteed.name: War Mage's Staff
guaranteed.description: Gifted by Markop. Quality magical focus with strong arcane resonance. Archie's first proper channeling tool.

guaranteed.name: Wraith Ectoplasm
guaranteed.description: Potent magical reagent harvested from the banished entity

guaranteed.name: Provisional Guild Card
guaranteed.description: Currently Active - Validated by Wraith combat performance
Demonstrated ice magic competency against Arcane Wraith

conditional.condition: Complete the ritual using only ice magic through the Staff

reward.name: Archie's Discipline
reward.description: Permanent +2 to ice magic control and focus checks

conditional.condition: Channel the Star Shard's energy successfully

reward.name: Bearer's Blessing
reward.description: Minor divine favor from the Toad God—once per day, stabilize a failing spell

conditional.condition: Humiliate Pernus Annmatar during the ritual

reward.description: Made a mockery of the establishment at the worst possible moment

conditional.condition: Perfect ritual execution with new Staff

reward.name: Full Guild License
reward.description: Permanent Mages' Guild membership—all warrants suspended

conditional.condition: Impress the Oracle(s) with magical contribution

reward.name: The Bearer's Recognition
reward.description: The Oracle(s) consider Archie worthy of deeper temporal secrets

milestones.title: The Confession
milestones.description: Archie posted the confession to Wahwire at 07:45. By 08:00, it had 2,000 likes and one official warrant.
outcomes: Public admission to the Greenhouse Inferno

milestones.title: The Solarium Test
milestones.description: Archie did NOT cast Fireball. He threw a twig. The Guild noticed. He has been issued a provisional license.

milestones.title: The Wraith Slayer
milestones.description: Defeated the Arcane Wraith using Ice magic. Collected the remains. Proved he is not a 'one-trick pony' to the watching Mages. The temperature drop gave the Oracle the opening needed for banishment.
outcomes: Used Ice Beam successfully in combat
Aided the Oracle in final banishment

milestones.title: The War Mage's Gift
milestones.description: Markop returned from the Silent Grove battle carrying the spoils of victory. Without hesitation, he handed Archie the War Mage's Staff recovered from the Arachnid Matriarch's hoard. 'You've earned it,' he said. For the first time, Archie holds a focus worthy of his power.
outcomes: Received War Mage's Staff from Markop
Staff resonance with ice magic confirmed

milestones.title: The Many Oracles
milestones.description: Returning to the Upper House, Archie witnessed the impossible: multiple Oracles existing simultaneously. One had been speaking with him and Hjumpik. Another led the rescue party back from the grove. When questioned, an Oracle revealed a 'Star Shard'—a crystalline gift from the Toad God—and declared himself a 'Bearer.' The ritual preparations began immediately.

milestones.title: The Separation Ritual
milestones.description: The Oracle insists there can be no hesitation. 'Hesitation desynchronizes intent.' The ritual to separate the bleeding timelines requires vast energy channeled through willing participants. Archie has a new Staff. He has proven his ice discipline. Now he must prove he can be part of something greater than himself.

goals.text: Channel energy through the War Mage's Staff
Protect the ritual from Legion interference

choices.title: War Mage's Staff Technique
choices.description: The new Staff responds to Archie's touch. How will he channel power through it?

options.name: Frozen Conduit
options.description: Channel pure cryomantic energy. The Staff's resonance with ice magic makes this the safest option. Maximum control, moderate power.

consequences.success: Perfect execution, full Guild license, Staff attunement complete
consequences.failure: Staff resonance wavers, ritual contribution reduced

options.name: Balanced Elements
options.description: Channel both ice and fire through the Staff, keeping them in perfect opposition. Extremely dangerous, but theoretically ideal for a 'separation' ritual.

consequences.success: Ritual supercharged, Staff permanently enhanced, theoretical breakthrough achieved
consequences.failure: Elements collide inside the Staff, catastrophic feedback

options.name: Bearer's Harmony
options.description: Attempt to synchronize the Staff with the Oracle's Star Shard. Unknown interaction. Potentially divine.
requirements: Faith in the Toad God (or willingness to fake it)

consequences.success: Staff infused with Star Shard energy, Bearer recognition, divine boon
consequences.failure: Shard rejects unworthy channeler, magical backlash

choices.title: The Heckler's Last Chance
choices.description: Pernus Annmatar will be watching the ritual. He will comment. He will judge. This is his final opportunity to undermine Archie—and Archie's final opportunity to silence him.

options.name: Professional Excellence
options.description: The best revenge is success. Let the ritual speak for itself.

consequences.success: Guild approves of maturity and focus

options.name: The Perfect Moment
options.description: Wait for Pernus to interrupt at the worst possible time, then redirect his energy into the ritual against his will.

consequences.success: Pernus becomes an unwilling power source, humiliated utterly

options.name: Frozen Finale
options.description: At the moment of ritual completion, create an ice sculpture of Pernus in an embarrassing pose. Non-lethal. Devastating.

consequences.success: Legend status among junior mages, Pernus's dignity destroyed

archie_god_toad_hunt.title: An Audience with a God
archie_god_toad_hunt.subtitle: Sins of the Father
archie_god_toad_hunt.objective: Confront the 'God Toad' (formerly known as the Evil Toad) to understand the nature of the Star Fragments and atone for creating him.
archie_god_toad_hunt.description: Archie didn't just betray his former boss; he accidentally ascended him. The toad once known as 'Orange T' utilized a Star Fragment to become a warping divinity. Now allied with Fawful, this 'God Toad' represents a cosmological threat that Archie feels personally responsible for. To fix this, he must enter the heart of Fawful's territory and stare his creation in the many, many eyes.Bones, having decoded intelligence files from a leather satchel, revealed crucial information about threats, allies, and long-term concerns relevant to the quest. Archie later found detailed notes left behind by a spy, hinting at further complications.While traversing Fawful's territory, the party encountered a satyr singing of the Iron Legion, a group potentially connected to Toad's god. They later danced with the Iron Legion themselves, successfully distracting them. A goblin guard was also encountered, but ultimately spared.

guaranteed.name: Truth of the Star
guaranteed.description: Understanding the fragment's origin

milestones.title: Locate the God
milestones.description: Archie confirmed the God Toad's presence at Fawful's Gala. The aura was unmistakable.

milestones.title: Infiltrate the Castle
milestones.description: Fawful's Castle is a fortress of madness. Archie needs a way in that doesn't involve being eaten by a mechanical midbus.

milestones.title: The Audience
milestones.description: Speak the words that need to be spoken. Survive the answer.

archie_third_eye_escape.title: The Third Eye Escape
archie_third_eye_escape.subtitle: A Trip Through Nowhere
archie_third_eye_escape.objective: Escape Cohort custody and survive the dimensional jaunt.
archie_third_eye_escape.description: Captured by Speaker L's Pond Patrol, Archie was moments away from a tribunal. In a flash of desperation, he activated his 'Third Eye' ability, tearing a hole in space. He tumbled through a Rakasha relay station and a Mindflayer colony before crashing back into Raventree Manor. The experience has left him vibrating with residual dimensional energy.

guaranteed.name: Dimension Hop (Unstable)
guaranteed.description: Can teleport short distances, 50% chance of error

milestones.title: Escape Custody
milestones.description: Fled the 'Pond Patrol' with help from a spy.

milestones.title: Dimensional Drift
milestones.description: Survived the Rakasha relay and Mindflayer colony.

milestones.title: Return
milestones.description: Returned to Raventree Manor, slightly traumatized.

archie_jesters_masterpiece.title: The Jester's Masterpiece
archie_jesters_masterpiece.subtitle: Art Through Chaos
archie_jesters_masterpiece.objective: Create an act of chaos so profound it impresses the Cosmic Jesters.
archie_jesters_masterpiece.description: The Greenhouse Inferno was an accident, but the Jesters loved it. Now, Archie feels the pressure to perform. He wants to top it with a deliberate 'masterpiece'—a prank or act of destruction that defies logic and authority in equal measure.Archie found detailed notes left by a spy, potentially providing information useful for creating an act of chaos.

conditional.condition: Make the Empire laugh

reward.name: Jester's Cap
reward.description: Immunity to confusion effects

milestones.title: Conception
milestones.description: Identify a target worthy of the 'joke'.

milestones.title: Execution
milestones.description: Pull it off without getting caught.

milestones.title: Intelligence Gathering
milestones.description: Analyze the spy's notes for clues about targets, vulnerabilities, and potential consequences.

archie_kamek_conundrum.title: The Kamek Conundrum
archie_kamek_conundrum.objective: Secure leverage over Kamek to ensure safety within the Koopa alliance.
archie_kamek_conundrum.description: Kamek views Archie as a chaotic liability and a rival spellcaster. To ensure he doesn't 'accidentally' get targeted by a Magikoopa blast during the next battle, Archie needs dirt. Serious dirt.Bones has uncovered valuable intelligence about Kamek's vulnerabilities and potential threats to the Koopa alliance.

milestones.title: Dig for Dirt
milestones.description: Find embarrassing secrets or tactical weaknesses about Kamek.

milestones.title: Leverage Intelligence
milestones.description: Use Bones' intel to find a way to pressure Kamek into cooperation.

bones_identity_crisis.title: Bones' Identity
bones_identity_crisis.objective: Discover the nature of Bones' past connection with Byscilla Danos.
bones_identity_crisis.description: Bones was recognized by Byscilla Danos, suggesting a past connection that needs to be explored.Aurelian Corvinarus requested Bone, Ash, Chalk, and Iron from the party, suggesting Bones' identity might be tied to these materials.

markop_vessel_investigation.title: The Vessel Investigation
markop_vessel_investigation.subtitle: Uncovering a Necromancer's Plot
markop_vessel_investigation.objective: Uncover the Oracle's true plan, find a way to stop the 'Vessel' from awakening, and escape the dimension.
markop_vessel_investigation.description: Markop and Remi are trapped with the Oracle in the 'Fractured Atrium,' a dimension of decaying reality. They have discovered his hidden necromancy lab, containing a dormant 'Vessel' and notes detailing his plan. After witnessing visions of the other fractured timelines, they understand the Oracle's goal is to force a convergence. Their mission is now to stop him before he can awaken the creature.

guaranteed.name: The Oracle's Notes
guaranteed.description: Proof that the Oracle is a necromantic researcher.

guaranteed.name: The Convergence Protocol
guaranteed.description: Details on how the timelines will be merged.

milestones.title: The Atrium
milestones.description: Became trapped in the unstable dimension with the Oracle.

milestones.title: The Laboratory
milestones.description: Discovered the hidden necromancy lab, the 'Vessel' tank, and the Oracle's research notes.

milestones.title: The Vision
milestones.description: Breached the ballroom and witnessed flickering visions of the Shadowfell dinner party, realizing the timelines were connected.

milestones.title: The Final Assault
milestones.description: Prepare to synchronize an attack with the other teams to stop the Convergence Protocol and defeat the Oracle.

markop_void_vigil.title: The Void Vigil
markop_void_vigil.subtitle: Staring Back
markop_void_vigil.objective: Maintain sanity while protecting the Oracle/Star Shard in the Void layer between dimensions.
markop_void_vigil.description: The edges of the manor have peeled away to Shadow and Fey, leaving Markop, Remi, and the Oracle in the center—which is now a platform floating in the Deep Mirror (The Void). The 'Something Older' that the Empire was digging for is here. It is scratching at the underside of the platform. Markop must hold the line.

guaranteed.name: Glimpse of the End
guaranteed.description: Saw what lies beneath reality.

milestones.title: Shield the Light
milestones.description: The Star Shard attracts the Void entities. Keep them away from the Oracle.

milestones.title: Don't Look Down
milestones.description: Resist the urge to look into the infinite dark.

markop_silver_flame_schism.title: The Silver Flame's Schism
markop_silver_flame_schism.subtitle: Faith Against Zealotry
markop_silver_flame_schism.objective: Aid the moderate faction of the Silver Flame against High Inquisitor Vale.
markop_silver_flame_schism.description: The Order of the Silver Flame is at war with itself. High Inquisitor Vale has launched a brutal purge of 'non-human sympathizers', turning the order into a weapon of the Regal Empire. Captain Dorn, a moderate Templar, has reached out to Markop. He believes Vale is corrupted by a darker power and needs Markop's help to expose him before the Order is irrevocably stained.

consequences.success: Vale is deposed. The Silver Flame returns to its noble roots. Markop gains powerful allies.
consequences.failure: The moderates are purged. The Order becomes a fanatical enemy of the party.
consequences.partial: A civil war erupts within the Order, neutralizing them as a threat but destroying their power.

guaranteed.name: Sun-Blessed Blade
guaranteed.description: Weapon effective against undead and demons

conditional.condition: Expose Vale publicly

reward.description: Champion of the Faith
reward.name: Hero of the Flame

conditional.condition: Avoid killing Templars

reward.name: Pacifist's Aura
reward.description: Enemies hesitate to attack you

milestones.title: Contact Dorn
milestones.description: Meet the Templar emissary in secret at the ruined chapel.

milestones.title: Infiltrate Archive
milestones.description: Break into the Cathedral's restricted archives to find proof of Vale's corruption.

milestones.title: The Synod
milestones.description: Present the evidence to the Council of Cardinals.

markop_serpents_key.title: The Serpent's Key
markop_serpents_key.subtitle: Legacy of the Time War
markop_serpents_key.objective: Investigate the key given by Green T and the time loop.
markop_serpents_key.description: Before he was taken by the mirror, Green T slipped Markop a heavy, serpent-headed key. It radiated a cold, temporal energy. Markop followed the pull of the key to a hidden section of the Raventree grounds—an abandoned manor that existed in a different time. There, he discovered the 'Book of Obituaries', listing names of people who hadn't died yet, and realized the Oracle's family has been fighting a losing war against time for centuries.

guaranteed.name: Temporal Insight
guaranteed.description: Understanding of the manor's true nature

milestones.title: Accept the Key
milestones.description: Received from Green T moments before his abduction.

milestones.title: The Hidden House
milestones.description: Navigated the living hedge maze to the abandoned manor.

milestones.title: The Time War
milestones.description: Discovered the obituary book and the history of the Oracle.

markop_paladins_penance.title: A Paladin's Penance
markop_paladins_penance.objective: Protect a vulnerable community to rediscover his purpose.
markop_paladins_penance.description: Markop feels his code has been compromised by the party's chaotic actions. He seeks to define his own path by protecting those forgotten by the major powers—not for glory, but for duty.

milestones.title: Find a Village
milestones.description: Locate a settlement in need of a protector.

markop_centaurs_burden.title: The Centaur's Burden
markop_centaurs_burden.objective: Deal with the arrest warrant issued by his old friend, Justicar Valerius.
markop_centaurs_burden.description: An Oathbound Judge—and Markop's former mentor—has issued a summons. Markop is accused of 'Consorting with Anomalies'. He must choose to answer the summons and argue his case, or flee and become a true outlaw.

milestones.title: The Summons
milestones.description: Receive the formal writ carried by the clockwork owl.

milestones.title: The Meeting
milestones.description: Confront Valerius at the Hall of Judgment.

hjumpik_feywild_heist.title: The Grand Manor Heist
hjumpik_feywild_heist.subtitle: Vines, Visions, and Vintage Wine
hjumpik_feywild_heist.objective: Gather ritual ingredients (Bone, Ash, Chalk, Iron) to repair the circle, manage Wario's chaotic interference, and solve the mystery of the 'Grafting'.
hjumpik_feywild_heist.description: The Feywild Manor is a chaotic puzzle. Hjumpik has uncovered the dark history of the Corvinarus bloodline: a 'Grafting' of Dragon Blood in 988 BF that created the heir. Wario has crashed the party (literally) with a bomb and vintage vampire wine. Aurelian Corvinarus is willing to help send the Satyrs to the Shadowfell, but she needs the Master Bedroom's magic circle repaired. The clock is ticking—Aurelian says it takes 4 days, but the Legion makes their move in 2.Bones decodes intelligence files from a leather satchel containing information about threats, allies, and long-term concerns. This may contain valuable clues about gathering the ritual ingredients.Aurelian Corvinarus explained that these ingredients are needed to repair the magic circle in the Master Bedroom, a crucial step in sending the Satyrs to the Shadowfell.

guaranteed.name: The Morning Glory
guaranteed.description: A flower-staff looted by Waluigi. Becomes a blade in sunlight.

guaranteed.name: Vampire Vintage (687 BF)
guaranteed.description: Heals 3d8+3, grants Darkvision, registers user as Undead. Provided by Wario.

guaranteed.name: Usk's True Nature
guaranteed.description: Knowledge that Usk is a Fog Spirit/Elf binding the timelines.

conditional.condition: Prevent Wario from blowing up the roof

reward.description: Kept the Manor intact

conditional.condition: Successfully banish Satyrs to Shadowfell

reward.name: Shadowfell Distraction
reward.description: Satyrs invade the Vampire Dinner, aiding Archie's escape.

milestones.title: The Vine Room Puzzle
milestones.description: Used the Shy Guy toy to discover the keywords: 'Corvinarus', 'Oracle', 'Cornelius'. Unlocked the bio-lock.

milestones.title: The Vision of 988
milestones.description: Hjumpik touched the statue. Witnessed the 'Grafting'—a Dragon Egg sacrificed to bind the bloodline. Confirmed the family's power is stolen dragon magic.

milestones.title: The Merchant's Entrance
milestones.description: Wario fell through the ceiling. Provided lore on the Shadowfell (Ruined Manor) and supplied items, but damaged the chalk circle.

milestones.title: The Ritual Circle
milestones.description: Aurelian needs Bone, Ash, Chalk, and Iron to fix the circle in the Master Bedroom. Wario ruined the current chalk. Hjumpik must scavenge superior materials.

milestones.title: The Roof Bomb
milestones.description: Wario is climbing to the roof with a ticking present to blow up the 'Dragonfly'. This might collapse the house. Hjumpik must intervene.

sessionNotes.content: Hjumpik negotiated to retrieve dried papers from Wario's room.
Discussed using teleportation and diversions to scout the creature's location.

wario_roof_hazard.title: Greed Above, Doom Below
wario_roof_hazard.subtitle: Wario's Demolition Service
wario_roof_hazard.objective: Prevent Wario from collapsing the Manor's roof while securing his 'Cannonball' (Iron) and 'Counterfeit Chalk' for the ritual.
wario_roof_hazard.description:
Wario has climbed to the roof with a ticking present (bomb). He intends to blow up the 'Giant Dragonfly' to loot its heart. 

Problem 1: The explosion will likely collapse the Master Bedroom ceiling, ruining the ritual circle.
Problem 2: Wario possesses the **Iron** (Cannonball) and **Chalk** (Counterfeit Kit) needed to fix the circle.

Hjumpik must either help Wario kill the beast safely to get the loot, or steal the items and defuse the situation before the roof comes down.

consequences.success: Wario gets his loot, Hjumpik gets the ingredients, the roof stays intact.
consequences.failure: The roof collapses. Debris crushes the ritual circle in the Feywild AND falls through to the Shadowfell, potentially injuring Archie. The Ritual is delayed by days.
consequences.partial: The beast is dead, but the Cannonball is lost in the fight.

guaranteed.name: Wario's Cannonball
guaranteed.description: Pure Iron. Perfect for the ritual.

guaranteed.name: Counterfeit Chalk
guaranteed.description: High-quality alchemical chalk. Perfect for the ritual.

conditional.condition: Help Wario profit

reward.description: Wario's 'Consulting Fee' cut.

conditional.condition: Waluigi reunites with Wario

reward.name: Wah-Synergy
reward.description: Waluigi and Wario gain combat bonuses when fighting together.

milestones.title: The Climb
milestones.description: Chase Wario to the roof before the timer runs out.

milestones.title: The Deal
milestones.description: Negotiate for the Cannonball and Chalk. Wario only understands leverage (Gold or Loot).

sessionNotes.content: A monster attacked the group, causing chaos and eating a butler.

hjumpik_mirror_identity.title: The Reflection's Gamble
hjumpik_mirror_identity.subtitle: Red vs Blue
hjumpik_mirror_identity.objective: Escape the Mirror Library and defeat the 'Blue hjumpik' while the 'Red hjumpik' deceives the party in reality.
hjumpik_mirror_identity.description: During the battle with the Shard Stalker, hjumpik was pulled into the mirror dimension. Faced with a choice between violence and mercy, hjumpik chose mercy at the urging of a Legion Spy also trapped within. This choice allowed him to return to reality, displacing the 'Red' impostor and saving the creature from execution by the Mages' Guild.

consequences.success: hjumpik returns to his body. The Red hjumpik is exposed.
consequences.failure: hjumpik remains trapped forever. The Red hjumpik infiltrates the party permanently.
consequences.partial: hjumpik returns, but the Red hjumpik escapes into the world.

guaranteed.name: Shattered Sight
guaranteed.description: Ability to see through illusions

milestones.title: The Swap
milestones.description: Pulled into the mirror by the Shard Stalker. Woke up in the Mirror Library.

milestones.title: The Choice
milestones.description: Confronted the Mirror Monster with a Legion Spy. Chose mercy over destruction, sparing the creature and returning to the real world.

hjumpik_legion_pact.title: The Legion's Mandate
hjumpik_legion_pact.subtitle: Entropy & Extraction
hjumpik_legion_pact.objective: Capture 'Orange T' (The God Toad) for the Legion using the Entropy Ring, then exfiltrate.
hjumpik_legion_pact.description: Hjumpik has successfully infiltrated the Feywild Manor, ostensibly serving Lady Aurelian Corvinarus as a troubleshooter to maintain his cover. The situation has complicated: he has met an 'Orange Heir' who denies being the Master, and the ghost of archmage Perrius Annmatar is telepathically demanding the Heir's death to fix the timeline. Hjumpik must navigate these conflicting demands, keep his cover, and continue charging the Entropy Ring to escape.The Iron Legion proved a formidable obstacle, their ranks marching with unwavering discipline. However, through quick thinking and a surprising display of rhythmic prowess, the party managed to distract them long enough to slip past unnoticed.

guaranteed.name: FNG's Diary Page
guaranteed.description: Notes on 'The Vessel' and Usk's role.

guaranteed.name: Morning Glory
guaranteed.description: A shapeshifting plant-weapon found by Waluigi.

milestones.title: Creature Identified
milestones.description: Discovered a creature that changes from green to dark purple; debating kill vs contain.

milestones.title: The Meeting
milestones.description: Accepted the deal with the Iron Legion.

milestones.title: The Charge
milestones.description: Used the Ring at the Midnight Gate Shrine. Contacted Agent H. Charge at 24%.

milestones.title: The Infiltration
milestones.description: Gained entry to the Manor. Evicted Satyrs and cleared the Vine Room to earn Lady Aurelian's trust. Met the 'Orange Heir' at the banquet.

milestones.title: The Ultimatum
milestones.description: Resolve the identity of the target. Perrius demands the Heir's death to sever the timeline; the Legion wants a capture. Hjumpik is investigating the family tree in the library to find a third option.

milestones.title: Iron Legion Encountered

remi_waluigi_espionage.title: WAH! A Little Espionage!
remi_waluigi_espionage.subtitle: The Purple Menace Needs a Favor
remi_waluigi_espionage.objective: Eavesdrop on an Imperial logistics meeting at the Port of Mighdural and report to Waluigi.
remi_waluigi_espionage.description:
Waluigi doesn't ask nicely. He appears, makes cryptic threats that might be jokes (or might not be), waves around objects that might be weapons (or might be props), and then tells you what you're going to do for him. It's less 'recruitment' and more 'aggressive volunteering.'

Remi has been aggressively volunteered.

The target is a meeting at the Port of Mighdural between a high-ranking Imperial logistics officer and a Merchant Prince. Waluigi wants to know what they're shipping. Not the manifests—those are lies. The real cargo. The kind of thing powerful people discuss in private rooms with guards at the doors.

The job is simple: plant a bug or find a listening position. Record the conversation. Get out. Report to Waluigi.

The complication is timing. The Iron Mandate just passed. Legion patrols have emergency powers. The Port of Mighdural is a major Imperial hub, and security has tightened considerably. A Toad caught spying on Imperial officials right now wouldn't face arrest—they'd face 'Order 120 adjacent' treatment.

Waluigi's payment is... Waluigi. An autographed Bob-omb (he swears it's defused, probably), some gold, and the dubious privilege of having Waluigi consider you an asset rather than an obstacle.

consequences.success: Waluigi gets his intelligence. Remi gains a chaotic but occasionally useful contact. The information might prove valuable to the party later.
consequences.failure: Remi is caught, killed, or compromised. Waluigi disavows all knowledge ('WAH! Never met her!').
consequences.partial: The recording is incomplete or the intelligence is partial. Waluigi is disappointed but not hostile.

guaranteed.description: A Bob-omb with a purple mustache drawn on it. Waluigi swears it's defused. The fuse looks suspicious.

guaranteed.name: Waluigi
guaranteed.description: Now considers you 'not completely useless.' This is high praise.

request_mid_lost_heirloom.title: Request: Lost Heirloom
request_mid_lost_heirloom.objective: An Imperial noble lost a priceless family signet ring while slumming it in the Grand Market of Mighdural. A significant reward is offered for its return, with a promise of 'no questions asked'.

request_mid_beast_hunt.title: Request: Beast Hunt
request_mid_beast_hunt.objective: The Iron Legion quartermaster at Aegis Command has put up a bounty for 'Wyvern Steaks' and 'Gryphon Pelts' to supplement troop rations. It's dangerous work, but the Legion pays well.

request_vm_caravan_guard.title: Request: Caravan Guards Needed
request_vm_caravan_guard.objective: The Merchants' Guildhall in Vemia City is hiring well-armed mercenaries to guard a valuable silk caravan traveling south through the bandit-infested Lower Hills.

request_iw_rare_herbs.title: Request: An Alchemist's Request
request_iw_rare_herbs.objective: The head alchemist at Fort Ironhand needs rare Ironwood Heart-leaf for his potions. The problem is, it only grows in a sacred Rakasha grove. He needs someone to 'acquire' it discreetly.

request_dm_radioactive_core.title: Request: Hazardous Salvage
request_dm_radioactive_core.objective: A notice from Lario at his makeshift workshop seeks 'disaster-proof professionals' to retrieve a 'slightly radioactive' power core from the Great Blast Crater on Dragon Mountain. Hazard pay is significant.

request_aw_spell_reversal.title: Request: Magical Mishap
request_aw_spell_reversal.objective: A frantic junior mage at the Spire has accidentally turned his master into a talking teacup. He needs a rare Moonpetal, found only in a fey-touched grove, to reverse the spell before his master is used for tea.

request_dc_tumbleweed_rustlers.title: Request: Tumbleweed Rustlers
request_dc_tumbleweed_rustlers.objective: Sheriff Cactus has put up a bounty for a notorious gang that has been stealing prize-winning tumbleweeds. It's a strange crime, but the town is taking it very seriously.

request_li_treasure_map.title: Request: Join My Crew!
request_li_treasure_map.objective: A charismatic pirate captain in Port Noir is looking for a crew to help him find the legendary treasure of the Sunken Temple of the Stars. A share of the treasure is promised to all who sign on.

request_tg_moon_herbs.title: Request: A Shaman's Need
request_tg_moon_herbs.objective: A Moonfang shaman at Alpha's Maw needs rare Blood-Lillies for a ritual. They only grow in the vampire-controlled gardens of Ebonspire Manor in the Jungle of Thorns. He offers a powerful blessing in return.

request_jt_food_taster.title: Request: Position Available - Food Taster
request_jt_food_taster.objective: A vampire noble at Ebonspire Manor is 'hiring' a food taster. The position offers luxurious accommodations and excellent pay. High turnover rate. Applicants should have a strong constitution.

request_bp_peace_offering.title: Request: A Delicate Mission
request_bp_peace_offering.objective: The elder of Windbreak Village needs a neutral party to deliver a peace offering to the local centaur clans to de-escalate recent tensions. The journey is long, and the centaurs are wary of outsiders.

request_ys_explore_ruins.title: Request: Adventurers Wanted
request_ys_explore_ruins.objective: The Mushroom Kingdom colonists at Port Toadstool West are funding an expedition into the nearby Ruined Abbey of the Silent Sisters and are looking for skilled adventurers to ensure its success.

request_lh_letter_delivery.title: Request: A Soldier's Plea
request_lh_letter_delivery.objective: A homesick Iron Legion soldier at Crossroads Keep wants to send a letter to his family in a village that is now behind rebel lines. He needs a discreet courier who can slip past the patrols.

request_yc_scarecrow_menace.title: Request: Scarecrow Menace!
request_yc_scarecrow_menace.objective: A desperate farmer in the Yal Central Plains reports that his scarecrows have come to life and formed a small, menacing army. He's offering his prize-winning pig as a reward to whoever can 'de-stuff' them.

request_nl_supply_run.title: Request: Smuggle Medical Supplies
request_nl_supply_run.objective: The rebels at The Last Hearth are in desperate need of medical supplies. They have posted a request for a skilled group to smuggle a shipment past the Iron Legion blockade at Fort Desolation.

request_yb_sparring_partners.title: Request: Unconventional Sparring Partners
request_yb_sparring_partners.objective: A dueling instructor at the Belanorian Knightly Academy is looking for warriors with 'unconventional' fighting styles to challenge his students and broaden their horizons. Good pay for a good fight.

request_vm_lost_pet.title: Request: Lost Squeek!
request_vm_lost_pet.objective: A heartbroken smuggler has lost his prized pet, a rare and valuable Squeek named 'Nibbles', in the Vemia City Smuggler's Tunnels. He's offering a substantial reward for its safe return.

request_iw_legendary_beast.title: Request: The Great Hunt
request_iw_legendary_beast.objective: A Rakasha huntress is seeking partners for a dangerous hunt. She is tracking a legendary beast, the 'Shadow-Stalker', through the Ironwood Forest and needs assistance to take it down.

request_lw_vampire_bounty.objective: The Silver Flame chapel is paying for any information leading to the location of a specific vampire spawn who is hiding among the populace of Oakhaven. They promise discretion for their informants.

request_aw_teleport_test.title: Request: Volunteers for Scientific Progress!

request_dc_prankster_bounty.title: Request: Bounty - Public Nuisance

request_tg_diplomatic_escort.title: Request: Diplomatic Escort
request_tg_diplomatic_escort.objective: A Silver Flame paladin at Fort Vigilance needs an escort for a 'diplomatic' mission to Alpha's Maw. Given the destination, he anticipates hostilities and needs protection.
